name: NW2Online
summary:
NW2Online is a Hungarian-developed MMORPG that operated successfully for 14 years, becoming one of the most well-known online fantasy games in Hungary.
Throughout its lifetime, it offered a unique community-driven experience with continuous updates, events, and expansions created by passionate Hungarian developers.

On April 6, 2025, the NW2Online servers were officially shut down.
Its dedicated player base was fully migrated to NextWorld2, a completely new generation MMORPG built from the ground up, carrying forward the spirit and legacy of NW2Online.
